description: This is a PHPUnit test class file for the PurgeStrategy component of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class 'PurgeStrategyTest' tests various methods of the abstract PurgeStrategy class, including retrieving purge services, match values, entity records, parameters, and entity class name. It uses PHPUnit mock objects and leverages test fixtures for setup.

classes.name: PurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class validating the behavior of PurgeStrategy subclasses in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates a mock of PurgeStrategy with specific entity class and info array, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetPurgeEmployeeService
methods.description: Verifies that getPurgeService() returns an instance of PurgeService.

methods.name: testGetMatchByValues
methods.description: Checks that getMatchByValues() returns correct criteria array based on input ID.

methods.name: testGetPurgeRecords
methods.description: Ensures getEntityRecords() retrieves the expected Employee entity record from the repository.

methods.name: testGetParameters
methods.description: Asserts that getParameters() returns the correct parameters array.

methods.name: testGetEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Checks that getEntityFieldMap() returns the appropriate field mapping array.
